one_liner: Multi-channel help desk and live chat software.

auth.evidence_quote: Connecting an AI client requires an authorization flow (OAuth 2.1 with PKCE) and a consent screen, so you explicitly approve which account the AI client can act as.
auth.notes: Core REST API v3 uses admin-issued API keys (per-key scoped permissions). The newer MCP server instead uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE.

access.evidence_quote: LiveAgent offers a 30-day free trial with no credit card required
access.notes: Sources conflict on whether a perpetual free plan exists; the confirmed self-serve path is the 30-day no-credit-card trial. Evidence quote from search summary, not a direct fetch of the pricing page.

api.evidence_quote: LiveAgent's MCP server exposes tickets, ticket messages, knowledge base articles, agents, and departments as tools an MCP-compatible AI client can call directly.
api.notes: Official MCP server with 33 tools covering tickets, custom fields, knowledge base, and team lookups; enforces per-account department/role permissions.

verdict.rationale: API key or OAuth credentials obtainable via a no-credit-card 30-day trial, with an official OAuth-based MCP server.
